name: Norte de Almería

known.via: English Wikipedia "Norte de Almería" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Spain's regional wine tier, below DO.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: An Andalusian vino de la tierra covering four municipalities in northern Almería: Chirivel, María, Vélez-Blanco and Vélez-Rubio.
